line.a_urodziny.text: We're going to the old oak. It's Owl's birthday today!

line.a_obietnica.text: And when we're back, a surprise is waiting for us at home.

line.a_pada.text: Oh no, it's raining! We'll get wet.

line.a_za_duze.text: They fall off because they're too big. They're my wellies.

line.a_jak.text: Then how do I know which ones are mine?

line.a_porownaj.text: We'll compare them! We'll lay one on the other.

line.a_kladziemy.text: I lay the small welly on the big one.

line.a_wystaje.text: See? The big one sticks out all around. This one is bigger.

line.a_wskaz_maly.text: And which one is smaller? Point to it.

line.a_nie_ten.text: That one stuck out all around. Point to the other one.

line.a_ubierz.text: Drag the big wellies to me, and the small ones to Squirrel.

line.a_pasuja.text: They fit! Now the rain can't bother us.

line.b_strumyk.text: A brook! How do we get across?

line.b_kamienie.text: On stones. But only a big stone will hold us.

line.b_most.text: Let's put stones in the water. Ready, here we go!

line.b_wskaz_duzy.text: Which stone will hold me? Point to the big one.

line.b_jeszcze.text: And one more. Point to the big stone.

line.b_utonal.text: Oh dear, the small stone sank. We need a big one.

line.b_przechodzimy.text: We crossed on the big stones!

line.c_zimno.text: Brr, I'm cold. The wind took my hat away.

line.c_pomozemy.text: Don't worry, Owl! We'll help you.

line.c_co_ogrzeje.text: What will keep Owl warm? Point to all of them.

line.c_glowka.text: Owl has a big head. Drag the hat that fits onto her.

line.c_szalik.text: And a scarf too. Drag it onto Owl.

line.c_dziekuje.text: So warm! Thank you, friends. That's the best present.

line.c_niespodzianka.text: Let's go home! The surprise is waiting!

line.p_start.text: Now let's play! We collect stars.

line.p_wiekszy.text: Which one is bigger? Point to it.

line.p_poloz.text: Look again. Which one is bigger?

line.p_wystaje.text: The bigger one sticks out all around.

line.p_lapanie.text: And now a catching game! Quick, point to the bigger one.

line.p_czapki.text: Drag the big cap to me, and the small one to Squirrel.

line.d_pudelko.text: Surprise! Point to the box, let's open it.

line.d_trzy.text: Three hats! The same, but different sizes.

line.d_zasada.text: The biggest hat for the biggest head, the smallest for the smallest. Drag them.

line.d_pieknie.text: Everyone has a hat that's just right!

line.d_rodzice.text: Ask your parents to compare the whole family's shoes with you. Lay one on the other!

line.b_zagrajmy.text: Let's play rock, paper, scissors! Whoever wins goes first.

line.b_znaki.text: A fist is rock, an open hand is paper, and two fingers are scissors.

line.b_pierwsza.text: I'll go first! Hop, hop, hop!
